branches.storyContract: Daniel alone accumulates awareness in the fixed last complete summer; outside history is unchanged.
Remaining beyond safe return is knowingly chosen; narrative beats advance deterioration, never real-world elapsed time.
Source erasure removes future activation without rewriting history; ordinary water and absent loved ones remain.

interruptionRules.afterDurableCommit: Resume the committed branch at its last validated milestone.
interruptionRules.saveFailure: Keep the previous state and show retry; do not acknowledge the ending as selected.
interruptionRules.duringConfirmation: Cancel the unconfirmed page on backgrounding and require fresh confirmation after resume.
interruptionRules.duringErasureEffect: Reconstruct visual state from the committed source_erased fact; never reapply side effects.
interruptionRules.endingReplay: Use an isolated session copied from C7S3.PRE_CHOICE; retain main playthrough.
